interpretation_ko: 뜻밖의 일로 즐거움을 얻고 사업이 나아질 조짐
interpretation_en: signifies that an unusual incident will cause you enjoyment, and improve your business conditions

cite.original: To dream of seeing turtles, signifies that an unusual incident will cause you enjoyment, and improve your business conditions.
cite.translation_ko: 거북들을 보는 꿈은, 뜻밖의 일로 즐거움을 얻고 사업이 나아질 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 떳떳하지 못한 얽힘에서 즐거움을 찾을 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that you will find pleasure in compromising intrigue

cite.original: To drink turtle soup, denotes that you will find pleasure in compromising intrigue.
cite.translation_ko: 거북 수프를 마시는 꿈은, 떳떳하지 못한 얽힘에서 즐거움을 찾을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 거북한 처지가 불만을 채우고 길동무가 자신을 헐뜯을 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes uncomfortable situations will fill you with discontent, and your companions will abuse you

cite.original: To see tweezers in a dream, denotes uncomfortable situations will fill you with discontent, and your companions will abuse you.
cite.translation_ko: 핀셋 꿈을 꾸면, 거북한 처지가 불만을 채우고 길동무가 자신을 헐뜯을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: warns you that your business is assuming complications which will be hard to overcome

cite.original: To see twine in your dream, warns you that your business is assuming complications which will be hard to overcome.
cite.translation_ko: 실타래를 보는 꿈은, 사업이 얽혀 감당하기 어려워질 조짐이다

interpretation_en: foretells security in business, and faithful and loving contentment in the home

cite.original: To dream of seeing twins, foretells security in business, and faithful and loving contentment in the home.
cite.translation_ko: 쌍둥이를 보는 꿈은, 사업이 굳건하고 집안이 화목할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: it signifies that you will have disappointment and grief

cite.original: If they are sickly, it signifies that you will have disappointment and grief.
cite.translation_ko: 쌍둥이가 병약한 꿈은, 낙담과 슬픔이 있을 조짐이다

cite.original: To see type in a dream, portends unpleasant transactions with friends.
cite.translation_ko: 활자 꿈을 꾸면, 벗과의 거래가 불쾌해질 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 운 좋은 투기로 사랑과 재물을 얻을 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells she will make fortunate speculations which will bring love and fortune

cite.original: For a woman to clean type, foretells she will make fortunate speculations which will bring love and fortune.
cite.translation_ko: 여성이 활자를 닦는 꿈은, 운 좋은 투기로 사랑과 재물을 얻을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 적을 조심하고 건강을 잘 살피라는 경고
interpretation_en: is a warning to beware of enemies, and look well to your health

cite.original: To dream that you are affected with this malady, is a warning to beware of enemies, and look well to your health.
cite.translation_ko: 스스로 장티푸스에 걸리는 꿈은, 적을 조심하고 건강을 잘 살피라는 경고다

interpretation_ko: 사업이 침체되고 늘 좋던 건강에도 언짢은 변화가 있을 조짐
interpretation_en: there will be depressions in business, and usual good health will undergo disagreeable changes

cite.original: If you dream that there is an epidemic of typhoid, there will be depressions in business, and usual good health will undergo disagreeable changes.
cite.translation_ko: 장티푸스가 유행함을 보는 꿈은, 사업이 침체되고 늘 좋던 건강에도 언짢은 변화가 있을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 연인과 다투고 앞날이 어두운 빛을 띨 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that you will have a difficulty with your sweetheart, and your prospects will assume a depressed shade

cite.original: To dream that you are ugly, denotes that you will have a difficulty with your sweetheart, and your prospects will assume a depressed shade.
cite.translation_ko: 스스로 못생겼다고 여기는 꿈은, 연인과 다투고 앞날이 어두운 빛을 띨 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 연인에게 무례하게 굴어 사이가 깨질 조짐
interpretation_en: she will conduct herself offensively toward her lover, which will probably cause a break in their pleasant associations

cite.original: If a young woman thinks herself ugly, she will conduct herself offensively toward her lover, which will probably cause a break in their pleasant associations.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 스스로 못생겼다고 여기는 꿈은, 연인에게 무례하게 굴어 사이가 깨질 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 벗을 잃고 사랑하는 이들과 멀어질 조짐이며 일이 계속 뜻대로 안 될 조짐
interpretation_en: signifies loss of friends and removal from loved ones. Affairs will remain unsatisfactory

cite.original: To see an ulcer in your dream, signifies loss of friends and removal from loved ones.  Affairs will remain unsatisfactory.
cite.translation_ko: 궤양을 보는 꿈은, 벗을 잃고 사랑하는 이들과 멀어질 조짐이며 일이 계속 뜻대로 안 될 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 어리석은 쾌락에 빠져 벗들에게 인기를 잃을 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that you will become unpopular with your friends by giving yourself up to foolish pleasures

cite.original: To dream that you have ulcers, denotes that you will become unpopular with your friends by giving yourself up to foolish pleasures.
cite.translation_ko: 스스로 궤양이 있는 꿈은, 어리석은 쾌락에 빠져 벗들에게 인기를 잃을 조짐이다
